Title: Second ex-staffer accuses Texas lawmaker of sending sexually explicit messages
Date: 2026-04-06

Content: “We didn’t so much as touch,” she told the San Antonio Express-News. Gonzales is married and a father of six children. He has said he intends to serve out his current term, which runs until January 2027, but dropped out of his re-election campaign after the House ethics committee announced an investigation into his relationship with Santos-Aviles, who died in September 2025. Gonzales’s political director told the San Antonio Express-News that her boss’s messages made her uncomfortable but not enough to quit her job. After Gonzales took office, she resigned from his team, citing political differences, and began volunteering for Brandon Herrera, a gun rights advocate who ran against Gonzales in March. After Gonzales halted his re-election campaign, Herrera became the Republican nominee for his seat in Congress. The former political director told the San Antonio Express-News that she decided to come forward with her story after hearing about Santos-Aviles’ death in March.

chunk_b.text_snippet:
Title: Texas lawmaker admits he had affair with aide who died by suicide
Date: 2026-03-05

Content: Gonzales, a father of six, first won his seat in 2020 after retiring from a 20-year career in the navy that included time in Iraq and Afghanistan. On Tuesday, he was forced into a May runoff against Brandon Herrera, a gun manufacturer and YouTube gun-rights influencer who narrowly lost to Gonzales in the 2024 primary. The San Antonio Express-News reported that it had obtained text messages in which the former Gonzales staffer wrote to a colleague that she had an affair with the congressman. Santos-Aviles, 35, died in September 2025 after setting herself on fire in the back yard of her home in Uvalde, Texas. The Bexar county medical examiner’s office later ruled her death a suicide.

initial_question.rag_input: How did the suicide of Santos-Aviles in September 2025 influence the chain of events that eventually caused Brandon Herrera to replace Gonzales as the Republican nominee?
initial_question.question: How did the suicide of Santos-Aviles in September 2025 influence the chain of events that eventually caused Brandon Herrera to replace Gonzales as the Republican nominee?
initial_question.answer: After the death of Santos-Aviles in September 2025, the San Antonio Express-News reported on Gonzales's affair with her and the House ethics committee subsequently launched an investigation into their relationship; this ethics investigation led Gonzales to drop his re-election campaign, allowing Brandon Herrera to become the Republican nominee for his seat.
